title: BAHI audit report
description: Federation audit view of an SHG chain: status, meeting roots with witness seals, deterministic hint flags, and a CSV export of all events. Verdicts are recomputed from the chain bytes; hints are advisory, never accusations.

group.description: SHG identifier, must match the chain file's group

chain_ok.description: true iff every event hash recomputes and every meeting root matches its receipt

first_bad_seq.description: seq of the first event that breaks the hash chain, null when chain_ok

why.description: machine verdict: MATCH, FORK-AT-EVENT-n, FORK-AT-MEETING-n, meeting-root-missing, quorum-fail, group-mismatch, corrupt-chain

witnesses.description: structural witness seals over the meeting root

hints.description: advisory flags, deterministic rules, never ML and never final

evidence.description: the rows that triggered the rule
